title: fix(cli): the flow-region gate never passes a flow it could not judge, and the boot banner counts refused flows
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9CRVFsFbBGh67CEn4YUnUGT)_

Fixes #29059

Clause-②: no

domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQBbn1k9FtQeh2nJSs

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os validate` / `os build` 的 flow 区域门禁在 FlowSchema 解析失败时不再静默放行，改为报一条带路径的 VALIDATION_ERROR；`os serve` / `os dev` 启动横幅新增一行「N flow(s) declared, M refused at registration」。
- 为什么改：卡 #29059 是 #29043 合同复审的四条应修项加 #28893 的启动半边：门禁的静默跳过、空转的盲区断言、未测的 packages[] 主体、过期计数，以及启动时被拒的 flow 只在 Boot diagnostics 里逐条出现。
- 风险与回滚：今天被拒或被收的 flow 都不变（解析失败分支对作者不可达，见下）；横幅只在有拒载时多一行，启动是否继续不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/utils/flow-region-shape.ts`（解析失败分支）、`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 的 `collectAutomationSummary`（拒载计数读 engine 自己的 `getFlowRegistration`）、`packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts` 的 `printAutomationSummary`（行序与全拒时的早返回）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/commands/serve-automation-refused.test.ts src/utils/flow-region-shape.test.ts`，预期 7 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

All five Wanted items of #29059.

1. **No silent pass on a parse failure** (`utils/flow-region-shape.ts`). `findFlowRegionRefusals` used to `return` with no row when `FlowSchema.safeParse` refused a flow. It now pushes a `VALIDATION_ERROR` row at the flow's `path`, named by the flow's `name` (or its path when it has no string name), carrying the schema's issues. The door refuses on it like any other row. New unit test `src/utils/flow-region-shape.test.ts` forces the branch (own flows, nameless body, `packages[]` entry).
2. **The blindness pin is no longer vacuous** (`test/authoring-rule-command-parity.test.ts`). Each `OUTSIDE_THE_TABLE` entry now names its `gate`, and the case first asserts that `gate(stack)` is non-empty and carries the marker, then that the registry run as `os lint` runs it reports nothing with the marker. The docblock now says it measures the registry, not the `os lint` command.
3. **`packages[]` subject tested end to end** (`test/validate-flow-region-shape.test.ts`). A two-entry assembled artifact with the malformed flow in the second entry: `os validate --json` and `os build --json` both exit 1 with exactly one region row `{ path: 'packages[1].manifest.flows[0]', code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', flow: 'rgn_ops_lead_time' }`, and build writes no `dist/`.
4. **Stale prose**: the parity file's test-budget header says "the ten rule cases" (nine `CASES` plus one `OUTSIDE_THE_TABLE`).
5. **Boot banner count** (`commands/serve.ts`, `utils/format.ts`). `collectAutomationSummary` takes the declared flows' names and counts those for which the engine's `getFlowRegistration(name).state` is `refused`. That read already exists on the engine and on `IAutomationService` (optional, the metadata door uses it), and the record behind it is written by the plugin's `kernel:ready` cold-boot bind (`recordFlowRefusal`). So no new engine or plugin surface. The banner prints `⚠ Flows:   N flow(s) declared, M refused at registration — …` after the Flows count line, and alone when every declared flow was refused (the old early return on `flowCount === 0` would have printed nothing). No line when nothing is refused. Whether boot continues is unchanged.

`AutomationReadySummary` gains `refusedCount`. It is not on any published entry of `@objectstack/cli` (`exports` is `.`, `./console`, `./hook-body`; `index.ts` re-exports only the `ServeCommand` default), and the banner is stderr text, so no JSON or published member changes.

**Forced test edits:** `src/utils/format.boot-warning-classes.test.ts` and `src/utils/format.flow-contender-agreement.test.ts` build `AutomationReadySummary` literals by hand; each gains `refusedCount: 0` because the member is required.

## Tests

Red first, by ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored and proven by blob hash equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`):

<details><summary>(1) parse failure: put the silent return back</summary>

On `03cc2f40`, `flow-region-shape.ts` anchor `if (!result.success) {` replaced by `if (result.success === false) { return; } if (false) {`: `src/utils/flow-region-shape.test.ts` 3 failed / 3, each `expected [] to deeply equal [ { path: 'flows[0]', … } ]`. (A first attempt whose replacement contained the anchor was refused by the tool as a no-op and restored; it is not counted.)
</details>

<details><summary>(2) vacuous pin: a fixture typo</summary>

Fixture edge `dy` rewired `d → y` to `x → y` (the catch region becomes single-exit): with this PR's assertion, `known gap` case 1 failed, `[]: expected [] to not deeply equal []`. Control leg, same typo with the new assertion deleted (the pin as on `main`): 1 passed. The old pin stayed green on a fixture nothing refuses.
</details>

<details><summary>(3) packages[] subject</summary>

`const subjects = entries.length > 0` → `false && …` (walk the empty top level only): the assembled case failed, `os validate` exit `+0`, expected 1. Path spelling `packages[N].manifest.` → `packages[N].`: failed with `path: "packages[1].flows[0]"` against the expected `packages[1].manifest.flows[0]`.
</details>

<details><summary>(5) boot banner count</summary>

`serve.ts` `refusedCount++` → `void 0`: `serve-automation-refused.test.ts` 2 failed / 4 (`refusedCount` 0). On `48c3a64c`, the all-refused branch's `printRefused();` → `void printRefused;`: 1 failed / 4, `expected [] to have a length of 1`. (On `03cc2f40`, the earlier line placement, gating the line on `flowCount > 0` failed the same case.)

The test drives the REAL `AutomationEngine` (dist): `registerFlow` refuses a one-branch `parallel`, the test records it the way the host's sync does, and the collector and the real `printServerReady` read it.

Real boot, one-off measurement (not kept as a test): `os serve` on a two-flow config with one one-branch `parallel`, `OS_DATABASE_URL=:memory:`, printed

```text
  ⚠ Flows:   2 flow(s) declared, 1 refused at registration — refused flows never run; each one's reason is under Boot diagnostics ('failed to register flow')
  Flows:   1 flow(s) 1 bound to triggers (record_change, schedule, time_relative, api)
```

with both `[Automation] failed to register flow` and `[Automation] cold-boot flow bind: failed to register flow` for `bt_fan` under Boot diagnostics, and boot continued to `Press Ctrl+C to stop`. (That run had the line before the count line; `48c3a64c` moved it after.)
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② stays `no`.** The parse-failure branch cannot be reached by an authored stack: every flow the walk reads was parsed by the stack schema's `flows: z.array(FlowSchema)` (and, under `packages[]`, by `AssembledPackageBodySchema`, whose collections come from the same stack shape), and `FlowSchema` accepts its own output. All existing validate/build/parity cases and the CONTROL case stay green, so nothing that passes today is refused.
- **What the count does not see.** It counts DECLARED flow names (the config, packages included). A runtime-authored `sys_metadata` flow the engine refuses is not declared, so it is not counted; its per-flow line under Boot diagnostics is unchanged. And the record is written by the `kernel:ready` bind; the boot pull's own refusals are deliberately not recorded (AGENTS.md "Startup registry reads"). A host with no `protocol` service runs no such bind, so its count reads 0 there while the warn still prints. Every `os serve` boot measured here has the bind.
- Integration tier: `test/authoring-rule-command-parity.test.ts` is integration (it spawns the CLI) and was run locally in full because it is edited; the rest of the integration tier is declared to CI.
